headline: Mark Twain is born in Missouri
post_facts: Born Samuel Clemens in Florida, Missouri
Pen name means 12 feet of water
Born and died with Halley's Comet

scenes.text: [warmly] On this day, in eighteen thirty-five... Mark Twain was born in Florida, Missouri.

scenes.label: Samuel Clemens
scenes.caption: Young Sam Clemens, about 1850
scenes.title: A boy of the Mississippi
scenes.text: [calmly] He grew up beside the Mississippi River.

scenes.label: of river water: the meaning of "mark twain"
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] His pen name was river slang for water twelve feet deep.

scenes.label: Mark Twain, 1907
scenes.caption: Photo by A.F. Bradley
scenes.title: Tom Sawyer and Huck Finn
scenes.text: [warmly] He gave us Tom Sawyer and Huckleberry Finn.

scenes.title: In with the comet, out with the comet
scenes.text: [softly] He was born with Halley's Comet, and said he would leave with it... In nineteen ten, he did.

scenes.title: Which Twain book was your first?
